title: Checking-a-name-for-grammar (transformer)
description: Input/output shape of checking-a-name-for-grammar: the subject is a name; the predicate is a grammar (the project's name-grammar). Output is a check-decision: conforms-boolean plus diagnostics enumerating any failed parse or any parsed component that did not resolve to its declared record on disk.

subject.description: The name being checked. A kebab-case identifier per the name JSON Schema.

predicate.description: The grammar the name is checked against. References the grammar JSON Schema.

output.description: A check-decision per the checking transformer's output schema.
